verdict_text:
NO

The merge formula computes `tmp = base + λ(ft1-base)`, then `tmp + λ(ft2-tmp)`, which expands to `base + λ(ft1-base) + λ(ft2-base) - λ²(ft2-base)`. This is not the required `base + λ(ft1-base) + λ(ft2-base)` (violates the arithmetic in Required result clause 2) — the second term is computed against the already-modified `tmp` instead of the unmodified `base`, exactly the ordering hazard the spec warns about. With λ=0.4 the extra `-λ²(ft2-base)` term is not negligible relative to the 1e-3 Frobenius tolerance in general, so grading would likely fail.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
